stories.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
stories.summary: An approach that lets agents reason in continuous latent space but commit to text only when acting — separating the interior work of thought from its outward form.

stories.title: William Gibson and the trademarking of cyberspace
stories.summary: How a word invented for a novel became a contested property — a reminder that naming a place is one way of claiming it.

stories.title: Rabbits were a medieval royal luxury in England until the Black Death
stories.summary: Rabbits shifted from a strictly royal privilege to a common food source after the Black Death — abundance dissolving a boundary that law had held.
